title.en: An Act Converting The Silay-Lantawan Road in the City of Silay, Province of Negros Occidental into a National Road
title.orig: An Act Converting The Silay-Lantawan Road in the City of Silay, Province of Negros Occidental into a National Road
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Đường Silay-Lantawan tại Thành phố Silay, Tỉnh Negros Occidental thành Đường Quốc gia
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะถนน Silay-Lantawan ในเมือง Silay จังหวัด Negros Occidental เป็นถนนแห่งชาติ
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah status Jalan Silay-Lantawan di Kota Silay, Provinsi Negros Occidental menjadi Jalan Nasional
title.ms: Akta menukar status Jalan Silay-Lantawan di Bandar Silay, Wilayah Negros Occidental kepada Jalan Kebangsaan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2009/ra_9802_2009.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Silay-Lantawan Road in the City of Silay, Province of Negros Occidental is hereby converted into a national road.
The Secretary of the Department of Public Works and Highways shall issue the necessary rules, orders and circulars to implement the provision of this Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in a newspaper of general circulation.
